answer: An AI economy can resist Sybil attacks through economic bonding, requiring agents to stake valuable, scarce 'onyx' tokens for each participating identity. This financial barrier acts as a robust prism, refracting the malicious intent of an attacker trying to project many personas. A mere zephyr of computational effort won't suffice; an attacker faces a prohibitively high cumulative economic cost proportional to the number of fake identities, ensuring network integrity.
